# Medical Transcription Services

> > Medical Transcription Services provides HIPAA-compliant EMR/EHR integrated transcription solutions for healthcare providers with 24/7 support across multiple platforms.

Medical Transcription Services specializes in seamless integration with major EHR/EMR systems including Cerner, Athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, and Practice Fusion. The company offers HIPAA and HL7 compliant transcription services with features like SOAP note support, physician dictation, and significant cost reduction potential for healthcare organizations.

- HIPAA Compliance
- EHR Integration

- Transcription Services
